question: An investigator is studying neuronal regeneration. For microscopic visualization of the neuron, an aniline stain is applied. After staining, only the soma and dendrites of the neurons are visualized, not the axon. Presence of which of the following cellular elements best explains this staining pattern?
analysis: The staining pattern where only the soma and dendrites of the neurons are visualized, not the axon, suggests that the stain is targeting cellular elements primarily found in the cell body and dendrites. Among the given options, the Golgi apparatus is known to be involved in processing and packaging proteins for transport, which are abundant in the soma and dendrites of neurons.
